phases.name: Presentation
phases.content: In this unit you will learn advanced connectors to structure formal arguments and essays.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.content: Read these sentences. Despite the rain, we went out. She studied hard so as to pass. The project failed due to poor planning. Notice the register: despite, so as to, due to are more formal.

phases.name: Guided practice
phases.prompt: ___ the bad weather, the event was a success.

phases.name: Free practice
phases.prompt: Write a short argumentative paragraph using at least 4 formal connectors.

phases.name: Mini-test
phases.prompt: The delay was ___ to technical problems.
phases.explanation: Due to is a formal way to express cause.
